Everything is complete and verified. Final summary of the implementation:

**`/app/submission/main.py`** (23,551 bytes, single regular file, stdlib-only: `json`, `re`, `sys`, `collections`, `hashlib`) implements Boundary Profile 1:

| Section | Implementation |
|---|---|
| **1. Envelope** | Strict JSON loader (unique keys at every level via `object_pairs_hook`, rejects NaN/Infinity via `parse_constant`, all fraction/exponent numbers via `parse_float`, BOM, malformed UTF-8, trailing data); exact key sets; ID grammar `[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,31}`; all count/range limits; alias canonicality, global ownership, default membership, anonymous-URI exclusion; peer modes with access=`[]`/relay allowlists; relay auth must be null; nondecreasing times. Invalid → no stdout, exit 2. |
| **2. URI language** | SIP/SIPS (case-insensitive scheme, single-decode `%HH` restricted to the user set, 1–64 decoded chars, DNS host with label/final-label rules ≤253, port 1–65535 canonicalized without leading zeros) and `tel` (separator removal, 3–15 digits, first digit 1–9). |
| **3. Request syntax** | First `\r\n\r\n` split only; body never parsed; CRLF-only endings; HTAB/0x20–0x7e byte rule; 65536/32768/8192/256 bounds; exact start line; `name OWS : value` with token names, folding (rstrip + one SP + lstrip), compact `f/t/i/l`; five singletons exactly once; Content-Length ≤10 digits matching body; From `;tag=TOKEN`, To≡target, Call-ID, CSeq, PAI/PPI comma splitting outside quotes/brackets with 1–2 address rules and SIP-first ordering, Privacy `id`/`none`. |
| **4. Trust policy** | Registry is the only authority; access: auth → discard PAI entirely → PPI (all aliases of auth account) or `[default]`; relay: PPI absent + PAI present, all PAI resolving to one allowed account; From must be an account alias or anonymous+`id`; projection `from`/`pai` per privacy×egress matrix. |
| **5. Ledger** | Expiry (`t >= insert_time + ttl`) before every event incl. malformed ones; key `(peer, Call-ID, CSeq, method)`; commitment (account, identity, pre-strip asserted list, input From URI, tag, target, privacy, egress, body digest); accept/replay(no refresh)/conflict(no replace); FIFO structure gives prefix expiry and oldest-index eviction at capacity. |
| **6. Output** | Eight-stage rejection order (`hex`→`syntax`→`headers`→`length`→`fields`→`auth`→`identity`→`conflict`), exact record key sets, counts summing to event count, `live` after the final event, exit 0 always on valid envelopes. |

Verified by the public example plus 13 self-written suites (~450 assertions) and 3 fuzzers (random bytes, grammar-directed, semantic) — zero crashes, all invariants held; 24 MB inputs process in <1 s under a 512 MiB / 30 s CPU ceiling.
